title: Devices are unencrypted despite an encryption policy

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} not encrypted despite being targeted

messages.businessImpact: The policy is deployed and the device is not encrypted, so the protection everyone believes is in place is absent on these machines specifically.
remediation: Check for a missing or disabled Trusted Platform Module, which is the usual cause.
Check whether silent encryption is enabled, since a user prompt left unanswered has the same effect.
messages.cannotSee: Which devices an encryption policy reaches is worked out from its assignments and the group membership this run read, so a policy assigned to a group whose members could not be read reaches nobody as far as this rule is concerned, and its devices are not judged. A policy assigned to all devices or all users is taken to reach every device. Why a targeted device is unencrypted, whether the policy failed, the hardware cannot comply, or encryption is simply still running, is not visible here; SEC-001 and CFG-004 ask the two questions either side of it.
